locator.text: Display 139.1, p. 139, in the proof of Proposition A.7

evidence: paper: j,m \ge 0, \qquad \left|(X\partial_X)^j \partial_\eta^m (E - E_{\mathrm{cl}})\right| \le C_{j,m}\, e_K X_K^{-1} x^{-A-1}, \qquad x \ge 1.

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has a weaker form of it. Lean has the pointwise x^{-A-1} bound only for j = 0, with derivatives in ν rather than η; the j = 1 case is stated only uniformly on a compact window, and j ≥ 2 and mixed jets are not stated.
